format: C++/Python hybrid (Pybind11 embedding in C++ source)
description: This file is an implementation module for PyTorch's autograd C++ backend, including initialization code that registers autograd and profiler functionalities, context managers, and various torch autograd API functions exposed to Python. It contains includes for both C++ core headers and Python embedding via pybind11, and defines functions and classes for autograd, autocast, dispatch modes, profiling, and tensor versioning.
